## How it was tested

- [ ] `make test` (vet, lint, unit tests)
- [ ] `make e2e` if the change touches migration, rules, types or files
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has a unit test

## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` …)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under "Unreleased" for user-visible changes
- [ ] No connection strings, keys or customer data in code, tests or screenshots
